image-alt.title: Image elements have [alt] attributes
image-alt.description: Informative elements should have short, descriptive alternative text. Decorative elements can be ignored with an empty alt attribute. Learn more.

aria-valid-attr-value.title: [aria-*] attributes have valid values
aria-valid-attr-value.description: Assistive technologies, like screen readers, can't use [aria-*] attributes with invalid values. Learn more.

button-type.title: Buttons have an accessible name
button-type.description: When a button doesn't have an accessible name, screen readers announce it as button, making it unusable for users who rely on screen readers. Learn more.

meta-viewport.title: Has a `<meta name="viewport">` tag with `width` or `initial-scale`
meta-viewport.description: User zoom is disabled by a missing viewport tag. Learn more.
